title: ROAMM
description: ROAMM is a large-scale multimodal dataset combining simultaneous EEG and eye-tracking recordings collected during naturalistic reading, with span-level mind-wandering annotations from 44 participants. It provides a benchmark for mind-wandering detection and EEG-to-text decoding, supporting research on attention-related degradation in language decoding from brain activity during naturalistic reading.
methods_description: Data were collected using a BioSemi ActiveTwo 64-channel EEG system with simultaneous eye-tracking via an SR Research EyeLink 1000 Plus, during a naturalistic reading task (ReMind) involving standardized articles and retrospective self-report of mind-wandering, along with page-level multiple-choice reading comprehension assessments.
